coverage: LLVM source coverage of Serf 1.3.10's HTTP/1 response bucket state machine (serf_bucket_response_create over serf_bucket_simple_create) and its header, body, and line-buffer buckets from a C11 byte-input harness compiled with clang
parser_family: Apache Serf 1.3.10 C HTTP/1 response bucket state machine (buckets/response_buckets.c); shares its parser family with the C++ path projects/http11/cpp/serf, which drives the same pinned sources, and is not an independent engine
